verdict.rationale: The transparency note says Copilot can store specific facts users ask it to remember and use them to give more relevant responses [copilot-docs-32]. It also says Copilot memory can drive personalized research suggestions [copilot-docs-33]. However, the documentation only describes explicit, user-requested memory, not automatic recall of relevant context from prior chats into new conversations. Missing for 10: automatic cross-conversation context recall, documented memory view/edit/delete controls, detail on how memory is applied in new chats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
